ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution approximately 70% high-intensity white and 30% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central region on both lobes; thick black peripheral border along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; multiple dark-intensity linear streaks crossing the white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 52 degrees at the central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated profile; left lobe contains distinct jagged peaks; right lobe trailing edge is heavily modified by high-contrast circular clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve from the medial notch extending upward toward tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly dense clusters of circular white spots (barnacles) concentrated on the black distal tips and lower trailing edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple sets of parallel dark-pigmented rake marks crossing the central white regions of both lobes, most prominent on the inner right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across the ventral surface and significant barnacle encrustations on the trailing edges and tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible yellowish/cream-colored biofilm or staining across the central high-intensity white regions.
